usedFor: Currencyapi supplies exchange rates, so “Currency Converter” can price an invoice or booking in a target currency.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in FreeAgent, then “Currency Converter” in Currencyapi
bestTemplate.why: A new invoice carries an amount, and the action fetches up-to-date rates for the target currencies.

watchOut: AI agents run on a schedule or when asked, so the rate from “Currency Converter” is from that run.
